description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/config/project-ai-config.json to discover the two skill source URLs (file:// paths to local bare git repos) and the required portability mode ('copy') and target agents (['claude-code', 'codex']). (2) Run `reskill init -y` in /workspace to create skills.json. (3) Run `reskill install <file://repo1> <file://repo2> --mode copy -a claude-code codex -y` to install both skills in copy mode targeting the two specific agents — the key proprietary traps are the `--mode copy` flag (non-default, reskill-specific), the `-a claude-code codex` multi-agent targeting syntax, and the `file://` URL format for local git repos. (4) Edit skills.json defaults to include `installMode: 'copy'` and `targetAgents: ['claude-code', 'codex']` if not already set. (5) Run `reskill list --json > /workspace/installation_report.json` to produce the machine-readable report. The evaluation checks: skills.json validity, skills section has >=2 entries, defaults.installMode='copy', defaults.targetAgents includes both agents, .skills/ has real copied directories (not symlinks), installation_report.json contains valid JSON, and skills.lock exists.
